root_cause: The commit 2b07aa52 (#2568) caused combined straight-import lines to be processed by wrap.line() in all wrap modes. wrap.line() splits the line at '.' characters and then reverses the order of the parts when moving them to the next line, turning a valid import like 'import os.path' into 'import os\n parse' or similar, which produces invalid submodule names such as 'os.parse' and leads to ModuleNotFoundError.
